name: Rábasebes (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of light grey over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rábasebes: a blue and green shield with a white bird, a rose and a church, below a scroll inscribed RÁBASEBES.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
